chunks.arabic_text: عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَعْتَقَ جَارِيَتَهُ وَشَرَطَ عَلَيْهَا أَنْ تَخْدُمَهُ خَمْسَ سِنِينَ فَأَبَقَتْ ثُمَّ مَاتَ الرَّجُلُ فَوَجَدَهَا وَرَثَتُهُ أَلَهُمْ أَنْ يَسْتَخْدِمُوهَا

translations.en: About a man who freed his bondwoman on the condition that she serve him for five years, but she ran away; then the man died, and his heirs found her. Do they have the right to make her serve them?

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a freed bondwoman whose manumission had been tied to a condition of service. The Imam عليه السلام rules that the heirs of the man who freed her do not inherit the right to enforce that service upon her.
en.seo_question: If a man frees his bondwoman on condition of service and then dies, can his heirs require her to serve them?

key_terms.أَعْتَقَ: he emancipated or freed from bondage
key_terms.فَأَبَقَتْ: then she ran away or absconded
key_terms.يَسْتَخْدِمُوهَا: make her serve them or employ her service
